title: Barnsley's Fern
description: One point, four rules, and a weighted die. Each throw picks a rule, the rule moves the point, and the point is marked where it lands. Nothing draws a leaf — the fern is just everywhere the walk can go. Points are tinted by the rule that placed them, so the self-similarity is visible: the amber and teal halves are entire ferns folded into single leaflets. Five knobs on your phone reach into the matrices themselves — curl the stem, change how hard each step shrinks, twist and resize the leaflets, reweight the dice — and the plant redraws while you hold them, with the coefficients you are moving listed beside it.
action_hints: tap a named plant and watch the fern on the wall become a different one
curl the stem over until the fern is a fiddlehead
hold a knob and watch the matrices on the wall move with it
grow the bottom leaflets until they rival the whole plant
reweight the dice — same shape, but the points go somewhere else
roll a random plant, then put Barnsley's own numbers back
